data_policy: Strict verification from official competition organizers and open betting tip directories. No hallucinations. Missing factors are documented explicitly and penalized in scoring.

fields_provided: Supplementary Super League table snapshot 28 Aug 2026

fields_provided: To Win / Handicap / Total market listings

irregularities.title: OLBG HTML lacks machine-readable odds attributes
irregularities.detail: OLBG server HTML includes consensus ratios and line labels (e.g. +10.50) but no semantic decimal/American odds attributes. Prices are not published in static HTML.
irregularities.mitigation: Odds factor scored as missing when not sourced via ESPN; confidence capped.

irregularities.title: Competition stage and venue not on OLBG index
irregularities.detail: OLBG index lists fixture names and times but not competition name (NRL vs Super League) nor venue.
irregularities.mitigation: League inferred from team names joined to known NRL/Super League rosters; venue from team home ground mapping.

irregularities.title: No free key-less dummy-half / halves / prop availability feed
irregularities.detail: Key player indicators (dummy half, halves combination, starting props) have no structured public feed.
irregularities.mitigation: Recorded as missing, injury deductions only fire when explicit flag sourced.

irregularities.title: Social sentiment and analyst sentiment require paid X API
irregularities.detail: X requires paid API; scraping breaches terms. Specialist sites have no structured feed.
irregularities.mitigation: Excluded entirely, recorded as not available, never estimated.

irregularities.title: Weather forecasts not yet wired per venue at collection time
irregularities.detail: Open-Meteo per-venue weather is available but was not yet fetched for this slate snapshot. Heavy rain/wind remains unsourced for most matches.
irregularities.mitigation: Weather component defaults to neutral 5pts and is flagged missing; Under elevation only fires when rain/heavy flag is explicitly true.

irregularities.title: Super League scoring thresholds lowered
irregularities.detail: NRL averages higher totals than Super League. Prompt asks to adjust total thresholds down 4-6 points for Super League.
irregularities.mitigation: Engine marks Super League matches and notes threshold adjustment in reasoning.

irregularities.title: State of Origin squad disruption
irregularities.detail: Origin window creates squad disruption for NRL clubs. No structured feed flags affected clubs automatically.
irregularities.mitigation: Flag available via manual schedule check; defaults to not-origin-window and is documented.
